name: JEE Main (Engineering Entrance Exam)
summary: National entrance exam for admission to NITs, IIITs, and other centrally-funded technical institutes, and the qualifying stage for JEE Advanced (IITs).
eligibility: Passed Class 12 (or equivalent) in the last three years, or appearing in the current year
Candidates typically need Physics, Chemistry/Biology, and Mathematics in Class 12 (Mathematics is compulsory for B.Tech aspirants)
documents: Passport-size photograph and signature per NTA specification
fee: Roughly ₹1,000 for General category and ₹500 for women/reserved-category candidates (India centres, one paper); exact figures are set fresh each cycle in the official information bulletin.
process: Registration opens on jeemain.nta.nic.in, typically in two sessions (January and April)
Create an account, fill personal and academic details, upload documents
Pay the exam fee online and download the admit card before the exam
Appear for the computer-based test (Paper 1 for B.E./B.Tech, Paper 2 for B.Arch/B.Planning)
Result and percentile released; top scorers become eligible for JEE Advanced (IIT admission)

faq.question: How many attempts does JEE Main allow?
faq.answer: JEE Main is usually conducted in two sessions a year (January and April), and a candidate can appear in both — effectively two attempts per year, with the better of the two scores counted.

faq.question: Is JEE Main the same as JEE Advanced?
faq.answer: No. JEE Main is the qualifying exam for NIT/IIIT admission and for eligibility to sit JEE Advanced, which is the separate, harder exam required specifically for IIT admission.
